title: Scenario F — Full demo: launch the sentiment model
description: Seventeen messages covering assignment, acknowledgement, an open call and a volunteer, chained, fan-in and fan-out dependencies, a date change with confirmation, a past-event message, completion unblocking work, progress, a held cycle and a cancelled prerequisite.

messages.text: Anushree, please collect the customer reviews by Monday.

expected.note: New task for Anushree with a due date. Only Anushree can accept it.

messages.text: Sure, I'll collect the customer reviews.

expected.note: Anushree acknowledges her own task: recognised, no duplicate is created.

messages.text: Anushree, please clean the review dataset by Tuesday once you collect the customer reviews.

expected.note: Second task for Anushree that waits on the first: a 'once ...' clause naming an existing task (chain step 1).

messages.text: Bianca, please train the sentiment model by November 18 once the review dataset is cleaned.

expected.note: Task for Bianca that waits on Anushree's cleaning (chain step 2, across people).

messages.text: Bianca, please write the evaluation script by Thursday.

expected.note: An independent task with a deadline.

messages.text: Can someone set up the demo server?

expected.note: Open call to everyone: no one is named, so the task is proposed as unassigned (anyone may accept it).

messages.text: I can set up the demo server.

expected.note: Anushree volunteers: the unowned task is assigned to her.

messages.text: Bianca, please build the demo dashboard by November 20 after you train the sentiment model.

expected.note: Dashboard waits on training ('after ...' clause): chain step 3.

messages.text: The demo dashboard is waiting on the demo server. The demo dashboard is blocked by the evaluation script.

expected.note: Two explicit dependency cues between existing tasks: the dashboard now waits on three tasks (fan-in).

messages.text: Bianca, please share the results report after you write the evaluation script.

expected.note: A second task waits on the evaluation script, which now blocks two tasks (fan-out).

messages.text: The office wifi went down yesterday.

expected.note: A report about the past: recognised as not a to-do.

messages.text: Could we move the evaluation script deadline to Friday?

expected.note: Bianca asks for a new date: proposed only, the due date does not change yet.
Riya agrees: the new date applies once this confirmation is accepted.

messages.text: I've finished collecting the customer reviews.

expected.note: Completion: once accepted, cleaning the dataset is no longer blocked.

messages.text: I'm working on the review dataset now.

expected.note: Progress update: the cleaning task moves to In progress.

messages.text: The sentiment model is waiting on the demo dashboard.

expected.note: This would close a loop (the dashboard already waits on the model), so it is held for review instead of breaking the graph.

messages.text: We no longer need the evaluation script.

expected.note: Cancelling a prerequisite does not count as done: the results report (which waited only on it) is flagged for review; the dashboard stays blocked by training.
